title: The Lamprey Clamps On With Rings of Teeth and Drinks Blood

scenes.text: This fish clamps on and drinks blood.
A lamprey has a round sucker mouth lined with rings of sharp teeth.
A rasping tongue tears open the skin.
Chemicals in its saliva stop the blood from clotting.
It breathes through gill slits, so it never has to let go.
When it invaded the Great Lakes, it decimated the lake trout.

description:
The sea lamprey clamps onto fish with a round, tooth-lined mouth and feeds on their blood.
Its invasion of the Great Lakes decimated lake trout and other fish stocks.
Would you swim in a lake with these?
first_comment: Would you swim in a lake with lampreys?
